finding: subprocess.run timeout is caught only by the outer generic exception branch. That branch preserves exception text and earlier consumer records, but does not copy TimeoutExpired stdout/stderr for the failing consumer into its receipt. text=True can also fail decoding a non-UTF8 result before a consumer record is appended.
scope: New isolated research consumer only; production sources unchanged. Successful v1 restore and its receipt remain valid.
proposal: Version2 stores an attempted-consumer record for success, nonzero exit, timeout and launch failure; captures bytes and exact hashes/base64 with replacement-decoded text for reading; no retries.
